messages.subject: inla.mesh.2d long loop
parts:
Dear group,

The inla.mesh.2d was looping indefinitely.  Based on previous posts, a solution is to jitter the locations.  But a small jitter does not work. Larger jitter works, but could affect the spde estimates. 

Is there any other solution without jittering?

Attached please find a test data and code, the inla.mesh.2d code did not stop.
